reviews.review:
Honestly. I am not sure what i expected. Maybe at the very least Football Coach College Dynasty which is a solid game. This one seems more like a very interesting 5 dollar mobile game at the moment. 

All that being said. This is 1 person making the game, I believe he cares and wants to make the best game possible so i am not here to discredit any of that. I would still get the game just to support the creator so that he feels like its a product worth investing in. 

The concept is amazing, I love OOTP and I love college football sims, This seems like it would be perfect for me, just not there yet for me personally aside from if i had it on my phone for 5 dollars. but yes would recommend still because i can appreciate someone taking the time to make this by themselves.

I have played a couple seasons since. I am trying my best to change my mind but its missing a lot. BUT i got hope. Still looks like the updates are meaningful and the guy cares a lot
reviews.developer_response: What are you looking for?  Maybe I can try to get in the game, or point you in direction of a game that you might like better.
